mainEntity.name: Why does legal time limits matter at the deadlines stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because clients usually need the topic translated into practical terms before they can decide what to do with it. Before the next step, legal time limits usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
